title: Grey four-fingered beings with a wand, telepathic instruction to comply

tellings.quote: I was told not to resist, not to fight. I wasn't in any danger. Just comply and everything will be all right.

plain: In 1976, on the Allagash Waterway in Maine, grey beings with four fingers took a man, held a wand, and told him with their minds not to resist: "I was told not to resist, not to fight. I wasn't in any danger. Just comply and everything will be all right." That is how Charlie Foltz, one of the men in what became known as the Allagash abductions, describes it to Michels; he says he lived it, and the case is the subject of a book called The Allagash Abductions. If true, it would be a direct account of beings controlling people with thought alone.
